paragraphs: Australian rules football clipart brings together the oval ball, scoring posts, boots, guernseys, umpire flags, and players practising distinctive kicks and handballs. Equipment studies and movement details make the Australian game easy to recognize.

The collection moves from close views of a ball and boots to player actions such as a drop punt or handball, giving you options for projects about the Australian code.
